name: Tower Tanks
description:
About This Game

Be prepared to get blown away (literally)! Tower Tanks is a chaotic co-op vehicle combat roguelike tank builder where you and your friends build, battle, and blow up epic screen-high tanks. Inspired by some of our favorite games such as Ultimate Chicken Horse, Besiege, and Lovers in a Dangerous Spacetime, it’s our spin on a uniquely wacky blend of co-op strategy and tactics.

BUILD FORTRESSES ON WHEELS

Build your tank together with your friends, piece by piece. Add rooms, weapons, defenses, rockets, refrigerators, and battlestations. Experiment with questionable builds and employ unconventional tactics against foes of usually comparable sizes.

ALL HANDS ON TANK!

Man your battlestations in the machine you've built. Aim the cannons, steer the throttle, repair damage, and keep the boilers hot. Scramble to keep your crew's creation rolling, not strolling.

NOW BLOW IT UP

Pilot your creation into the fray and let it earn its stripes. Send enemy tanks packing in pieces and brace yourselves for when everything falls apart. Like your grandpappy used to say: ‘The taller your tank, the bigger the boom.’

NO TWO RUNS ARE ALIKE

Set your course through roguelike campaigns with your friends. Complete objectives, reach new areas, and defeat huge bosses to unlock an ever-expanding arsenal of weapons, tools, stations, and OSHA-approved outfits. Every run uncovers new challenges where your teamwork will be tested.

ENLIST TODAY

Tower Tanks is only getting started! We're adding tons of new widgets, stations, roles, environments, and hazards—including a dedicated co-op Campaign Mode. Wishlist now!

Want to join the playtest crew, recruit? Join today to build, battle, and break what comes next!
short_desc: TEAM UP! BUILD UP! BLOW UP! Tower Tanks is a chaotic co-op vehicle combat roguelike where you and your friends build and crew giant war machines. Work together to customize your tank, power up the engines, put out fires, and man the guns as you blast apart anything in your way!
